title: Aston Martin DBX GT: Ultra Refinement, Effortless Performance
extract: Aston Martin has introduced the DBX GT, a more refined V8-powered interpretation of its high-performance SUV with revised suspension, quieter running, bespoke interior details and the same 3.1-second 0–60 mph performance as the DBX S.

title: Oscar Piastri questions the complexity of Formula 1’s 2026 regulations
extract: Oscar Piastri’s comments at Sepang highlighted the complexity of the 2026 Formula 1 cars and their increased reliance on simulator preparation, offering an interesting glimpse into how drivers are adapting to the new technical rules.

title: WRC Sardinia: Neuville snatches lead from Fourmaux
extract: Thierry Neuville took the Rally Italy Sardinia lead from Hyundai team-mate Adrien Fourmaux by just 0.4 seconds after a demanding Friday on rough gravel stages, with title contender Elfyn Evans also in contention.

title: Rally Italy Day 1 in photos
extract: Motorsport.com’s Day 1 gallery captures the 2026 Rally of Italy Sardinia, including the leading Hyundai, Toyota and M-Sport Ford Rally1 cars on the demanding gravel stages.

title: Ford’s return to WRC brings fresh interest to the 2026 championship
extract: Ford’s re-entry to the World Rally Championship is being framed around the renewed competition and character of modern rallying, adding a major manufacturer to the 2026 field.

title: 2027 Aston Martin DBX GT revealed with 717-hp V8
extract: The DBX GT replaces the DBX 707 in Aston Martin’s 2027 range with a 717-hp twin-turbo V8, 193-mph top speed and extensive chassis and cabin changes aimed at improving refinement.

title: US arrests tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M in Nvidia chips into China
extract: US prosecutors have charged a technology executive over an alleged scheme involving hundreds of millions of dollars of Nvidia-equipped servers being diverted to China using false paperwork.

title: systemd-appd proposed to centralize tracking of user applications
extract: A new systemd component called systemd-appd is being developed as a mechanism for centralizing information about applications running in a user session.

title: Imagination details its open-source Vulkan driver and future Volcanic architecture
extract: Imagination Technology has outlined progress on its open-source PowerVR Mesa Vulkan driver and its plans to support the company’s newer Volcanic GPU architecture.

title: Intel Iris open-source driver gains efficient 64-bit addressing
extract: Intel’s Iris Gallium3D driver has gained support for an efficient 64-bit GPU addressing mode, following hardware changes introduced with the company’s newer graphics architecture.

title: Coreboot 26.09 adds Framework Laptop 12 support
extract: Coreboot 26.09 has been released with new hardware support including the Framework Laptop 12, alongside changes to the project’s review process for AI-generated contributions.

title: KDE Linux nears a decision on its BuildStream-based image
extract: KDE Linux developers are approaching a decision on whether to ship a BuildStream-based operating-system image rather than relying on the traditional Arch package model.

title: The Secret of Monkey Island gets a full MSX2 conversion
extract: The classic Lucasfilm adventure The Secret of Monkey Island has been brought to MSX2, MSX2+ and Turbo R systems, giving another historically important home computer platform a version of the game.

title: Street Rod SDL3 port brings the 1989 racing classic to modern PCs
extract: The 1989 driving game Street Rod has received an SDL3-based modern PC port, preserving the classic racing experience while making it practical to run on current operating systems.

title: OutRun 2026 arrives on the Amstrad CPC
extract: A new Amstrad CPC 6128 conversion of the Master System version of Out Run recreates its branching stages, music and arcade-style driving on the 8-bit machine.

title: AirTiger Strike AGA brings a new helicopter shooter to Amiga
extract: AirTiger Strike AGA is a new Amiga 1200 shoot ’em up inspired by Desert Strike, using 256-colour AGA graphics, pre-rendered 3D vehicles and multiple environments.

title: Lemans 2 version 1.3c adds a new full-screen cover on Commodore 64
extract: ZeroG Labs has updated its Commodore 64 top-down racer Lemans 2 to version 1.3c, adding a new full-screen title cover while retaining its checkpoint-driven racing mechanics.

title: DOOM64 reimagines Doom for the Commodore 64
extract: Kweepa’s Commodore 64 project reinterprets the original Doom with deliberately tailored technical compromises, using the C64’s constraints to create a playable first-person shooter rather than attempting a literal port.

title: Ash brings Norwegian folklore to a new Amiga platforming quest
extract: Developer Thomas Mayer Foss is building Ash for the original Amiga 500, combining companion swapping, parallax scrolling and a fairy-tale adventure inspired by Norwegian folklore.

title: A Commodore 64 can boot Linux through an experimental RISC-V emulation hack
extract: Developer Onno Kortmann adapted the compact semu emulator so a Commodore 64 can emulate a 32-bit RISC-V system and boot Linux, albeit with substantial additional memory and very low performance.

title: A $10 board becomes a multisystem retro computer
extract: An experimental ESP32 project uses a small inexpensive board, SD storage and a bare-metal bootloader to turn one piece of hardware into a platform for emulating numerous classic computer systems.

title: DOOM64 uses technical compromises to fit a C64
extract: The DOOM64 project is an example of demake engineering, replacing the original game’s texture mapping and geometry with techniques suited to the Commodore 64’s processor and graphics hardware.

title: OutRun 2026 uses AI-assisted development on the Amstrad CPC
extract: The new Amstrad CPC 6128 Out Run conversion was developed with AI assistance while targeting the machine’s 128K memory and original-style display and sound capabilities.

title: AirTiger Strike AGA pushes the Amiga 1200’s graphics hardware
extract: AirTiger Strike AGA is an active Amiga 1200 development project using pre-rendered 3D vehicles, 256-colour AGA graphics and atmospheric effects to build a Desert Strike-inspired helicopter game.

title: Fleetwood Mac’s Mystery to Me highlighted by Rhino
extract: Rhino has revisited Fleetwood Mac’s 1973 album Mystery to Me as its Album of the Day, drawing attention to the record’s place in the band’s transition toward the sound that would make them international stars.

title: Nothing But Thieves feature in new music programming from Spanish public radio
extract: Spanish public radio’s October 1 music programme included Nothing But Thieves among its current music selections, alongside new material from contemporary artists and a discussion of recent releases.

title: Patek Philippe unveils seven Milan-exclusive watches
extract: Patek Philippe has introduced seven limited editions for its 2026 Watch Art Grand Exhibition in Milan, including an instantaneous perpetual-calendar chronograph, minute repeaters and an Italian-market Aquanaut.

title: Parmigiani Fleurier debuts the Toric Petite Seconde Morning Blue
extract: Parmigiani Fleurier has introduced the Toric Petite Seconde Morning Blue, pairing a 40.6mm platinum case and hand-grained gold dial with the manually wound rose-gold PF780 movement.

title: Moritz Grossmann introduces two dark Benu Power Reserve limited editions
extract: Moritz Grossmann has marked the bicentenary of founder Moritz Grossmann’s birth with two limited Benu Power Reserve editions that combine traditional Glashütte watchmaking with a darker contemporary treatment.

title: Mauron Musy creates a unique MU06 UniX for Watches for ELA
extract: Mauron Musy has created a one-off MU06 UniX in titanium for the Watches for ELA charity auction, featuring the brand’s four-segment case architecture and patented nO-Ring construction.

title: Marteau & Co announces its largest watch auction
extract: Geneva auction house Marteau & Co is preparing its largest sale to date, running from October 8 to 16 and featuring independent-watchmaking highlights including a De Bethune DB25 World Traveller.

title: Eric Wind and True North release the Vintage Rally Timer IV Dreamsicle
extract: The fourth Eric Wind and True North collaboration is the Vintage Rally Timer IV Dreamsicle, a collector-focused chronograph combining vintage-inspired styling with the pair’s continuing design collaboration.

title: The Fist of Memory by Wole Talabi gets a new spotlight
extract: Wole Talabi’s first science-fiction novel The Fist of Memory is a first-contact story about an alien spacecraft and the consequences of humanity’s encounter with it, due from Gollancz later in October.

title: As You Wake, Break the Shell opens a new science-fiction duology for Becky Chambers
extract: Becky Chambers’s forthcoming novel As You Wake, Break the Shell begins a new science-fiction duology, following a botanist and a pilot whose relationship is complicated by a connection to an enormous alien creature.

title: The French Illusion takes John Grisham into espionage territory
extract: John Grisham’s new novel The French Illusion leaves his usual courtroom setting for a spy thriller involving wartime crimes, Paris and a former Naval officer drawn into a dangerous mystery.

title: The CPO & The Wren draws on a Royal Navy family history
extract: Geoffrey Spinks’s historical novel The CPO & The Wren draws on his parents’ Second World War service in the Royal Navy and Women’s Royal Naval Service to explore wartime duty, relationships and family history.

title: Mothsblood receives a new excerpt and publishing spotlight
extract: Reactor has highlighted Lynn D. Jung’s Mothsblood, an ambitious fantasy about an alchemist uncovering dark secrets at a university while trying to escape its dangers.

title: The Weight of Angels is among new historical fiction arriving this autumn
extract: John Boyne’s The Weight of Angels is listed among the notable historical-fiction releases arriving in early October, expanding the current autumn field of historical novels.

title: Coyote vs. Acme reaches $100 million at the box office
extract: The long-delayed Looney Tunes feature Coyote vs. Acme has passed $100 million at the box office after its August release, giving the revived film a notable theatrical run after its earlier shelving.

title: The Sixty-Year Mission celebrates six decades of Star Trek on screen
extract: The documentary The Sixty-Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World is opening in cinemas, marking the franchise’s 60th anniversary with a look at its influence on television and popular culture.

title: Dracula returns to UK cinemas in a new 4K restoration
extract: Hammer’s 1958 Dracula is returning to UK cinemas in a new 4K restoration with material previously seen only in its original Japanese theatrical release, plus a new 5.1 surround mix.

title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor gets a UK release date
extract: The horror-comedy The Restoration at Grayson Manor has announced a November 6 UK and Ireland theatrical release after its festival run, accompanied by a new trailer.

title: Neagley renewed for a second season
extract: Prime Video has renewed the Reacher spin-off Neagley for a second season, extending the action series built around Maria Sten’s character Frances Neagley.

title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe renewed for season two
extract: The Max science-fiction comedy Stuart Fails to Save the Universe has been renewed for a second season after becoming one of the platform’s strongest comedy launches.
